form.s3DocText: When all components have the same VAT rate, the bundle is one line at the bundle price. When the rates differ, the document shows the components separately and the price is split proportionally. If a rate cannot be determined we do not guess: the document is held.

form.s3Lead: What to know about a gift in a bundle:
form.s3None: No component is a gift, so there is nothing to set here. You can continue, or mark a gift in the components.
form.s3Preview: This is how the gift would look on the document:
form.s3Rule1: The gift travels in the parcel at the bundle price: the customer does not pay for it separately.
form.s3Rule2: It comes off your stock and counts towards your cost.
form.s3Rule3: The form on the document only changes how the gift looks on the invoice or receipt, not the price or the stock.

gift.i1n: A place for a free gift

gift.summary: ships in the parcel, costs you
gift.title: Free gifts in a bundle

kind.giftBody: It ships in the parcel and costs you, not the buyer. Choose it when you add something to a purchase with no price of its own.
kind.giftName: Gift: a component inside the bundle price
kind.packBody: For example 3 x deodorant in one offer. N units come off stock per sale. Choose it when the buyer takes several of the same thing.
kind.packName: Multipack: the same product x N
kind.setBody: For example coffee and a mug at one price. Stock is the fewest of the components. Choose it when you sell different things together.
kind.setName: Bundle: several different products, one offer
kind.summary: three things that are easy to mix up
kind.title: Bundle, multipack or gift?

guide.lede: Bundle, multipack and gift in 3 steps: what goes in the parcel, how much you have and what the buyer sees.

new.i1n: Create the bundle product in OpenLinker
new.i1t: A bundle is an ordinary product with components. If it is not in your shop yet, OpenLinker creates it for you with a name, SKU, price and description. The same SKU saved twice does not create a second product. A shop that does not allow this is listed with the reason.
new.i2t: 1. Components and quantities. 2. The bundle product with a fixed price. 3. Gifts and how they appear on the document. 4. Review, save and send to the channels.
new.summary: OpenLinker creates it in the shop
new.title: A bundle as a new product

next.docBody: The document shows the bundle as one line. The parcel ships with the components. The label form shows a What to pack list.
next.offerBody: List the bundle on a channel. The channel gets the number of bundles as the offer's stock.
next.orderBody: The buyer pays for the bundle. On the order you see the components and a link to the bundle.
next.summary: from saving to the first parcel
next.title: What next: offer, order, document, parcel

offer.i1t: On a marketplace you list a bundle like any product. A bundle does not need its own EAN, because its products have the codes. If a component cannot be listed, the wizard shows it on the bundle and suggests what to do.
